channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Iran Says Strait of Hormuz 'Under Its Control' After Trump Threat
item.description: Tehran stated that the Strait of Hormuz is 'under Iran's control and management' following President Trump's comment that the U.S. might 'keep it.'

item.title: Costa Rica extradites top drug trafficker and cartel associate to U.S.
item.description: Gilbert Bell Fernandez expressed gratitude to the U.S. for removing him from Costa Rica, alleging mistreatment in prison.

item.title: American missionary kidnapped in Niger in October released, organization says
item.description: An American missionary abducted in Niger in October has been freed, according to his organization, which reports Kevin Rideout is in good health.

item.title: Democrats seek answers on conditions aboard USS Lincoln
item.description: The aircraft carrier has been deployed for over eight months.
